player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ SimpleTak.
Wɔ board no so, wo stones no pɛ sɛ '{player_stone}' na wo opponent no stones no pɛ sɛ '{opponent_stone}'.

Wɔ wo turn, wo nso wo empty cell baako (ne numbered index) na sie wo stone no.
Sɛ nhwɛ, '[12]' sie wo stone no wɔ cell 12.

Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛyɛ wo stones no continuous path a ɛbɛka board no opposite edges baako (soro-aseɛ anaasɛ benkum-nifa).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Sel dinamu {cell_num} yɛ biribi. Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛfiri 0 kɔsi {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Ɔdan {cell_num} no wɔ hɔ dedaw. Paw ɔdan a ɛnni mu biara.

action.placement: Ɔdan {current_player_id} de ne ho nsɛm ({symbol}) wɔ sel {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Owura {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') hyɛɛ nkyɛn abien a ɛne emu da!
outcome.draw: Wɔama ɔfã no ayɛ ma. Ɛte sɛ nea wɔasiesiee ade!
